Training

Details

Equipping professionals to solve Africa’s financial challenges.

Financial inclusion across Africa continues to face complex and evolving challenges — from the 23% who remain financially excluded, to MSMEs that still struggle to access finance, and many users who, despite increased access, have yet to achieve meaningful financial health. Addressing these realities requires more than access alone, it demands skilled professionals equipped to solve today’s problems and design tomorrow’s solutions. In response, FinMark Trust is launching Africa’s first end-to-end Learning-to-Implementation Continuum — a comprehensive capacity-building programme that moves from foundational learning to real-world use-case development, with sustained post-learning support.

If you’re ready to be part of the solution and build practical capability that delivers impact, get in touch with us today.

When
Late 2026 (five-day intensive)
Where
South Africa
Format
Masterclasses + track-based use case development
Faculty
African experts, policymakers, practitioners and FinMark Trust leadership
Partners
Alliance for Financial Inclusion, SADC Secretariat, Digital Frontiers Institute (endorsement pending)
